meta.purpose: Portable bootstrap queue for repos that adopt the shared 0.dev-matrix operating system.
notes: Adapt this queue to the repo before claiming delivery progress.
Keep at most two active tasks.
Use proof-driven validation on every task.

tasks.title: Adapt the queue to this repo's real current state
tasks.why: A copied 0.dev-matrix must be translated into repo truth before implementation starts.
tasks.definitionOfDone: AI-TASKS.json, NEXT-2-TASKS.md, TASK.md, STATE.md, and AI-HANDOFF.md all describe the same repo-specific active slice.
validation: Confirm the active pair in NEXT-2-TASKS.md matches the repo's real current priority.
tasks.businessValue: Prevents copied governance files from becoming stale theater instead of an operating system.

tasks.title: Generate the repo layout index and review orphan-file hints
tasks.why: Every repo should expose unlinked docs, orphan docs, and isolated scripts before deeper refactors or launches.
tasks.definitionOfDone: The repo layout index is generated and the resulting orphan-file or isolated-script hints are either accepted, archived, or queued for cleanup.
validation: Review graphify-out/repo-layout-index.json gap_hints and turn real issues into queue items or archives.
tasks.businessValue: Keeps the codebase connected and professional instead of accumulating orphaned operational junk.

tasks.title: Choose the first repo-specific launch or earning slice
tasks.why: The operating system should narrow work into one real revenue, launch, or runtime slice instead of generic productivity motion.
tasks.definitionOfDone: The repo's next slice is expressed as a falsifiable, proof-driven task with one cheapest validation command.
validation: The active slice has one explicit validation command.
The launch checklist and handoff agree on that same slice.
tasks.businessValue: Turns the dev-matrix from administration into delivery.

tasks.title: Implement the first repo-specific validated slice
tasks.why: The system exists to ship real working software, not just to define workflow rules.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A code, config, or runtime change lands with passing validation and truthful handoff evidence.
validation: Run the cheapest slice-level proof command.
Update AI-HANDOFF.md, STATE.md, TASK.md, and AI-TASKS.json with the result.
tasks.businessValue: Converts the operating system into working product progress.
